Test instrument-independence of negative controls (W | G | C)

Source: R/nc_diagnostics.R
nc_independence_check.Rd

For each control feature, computes the partial correlation with the genetic instrument G after residualising both on observed covariates C, and reports the p-value. Controls significantly associated with G after FDR correction may carry meQTL / allele-specific effects that violate the instrument-independence assumption (A2).

Usage

nc_independence_check(dat, fdr_level = 0.1, n_cores = 1)

Arguments

dat

Dataset list from run_single_iteration() or generate_toy_data().

fdr_level

Target FDR for BH correction. Default 0.10.

n_cores

Number of parallel workers. Default 1 (sequential). Uses parallel::mclapply on Unix and a PSOCK cluster on Windows.

Value

A data frame with one row per control feature: feature, partial_r, p_value, fdr, significant, verdict.

Examples

dat <- run_single_iteration(n_features = 10, seed = 1)
nc_independence_check(dat)
